BrochureContent.Content:
Nugent Auctioneers, 045 865 555, www.nugents.ie proudly presents No. 9 The Glen to the market, this attractive four/five bedroom detached property is superbly located at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac. The home is presented in turnkey condition, having been lovingly maintained by its current owners.

The property offers generous living accommodation ideally suited to growing families. The ground floor provides ample space, comprising of a spacious entrance hallway with guest WC off, a dedicated home office/bedroom 5, a sizeable kitchen with utility room. Additionally, there is a light-filled extension to the rear featuring velux windows and French doors opening onto the southeast-facing garden. There is also an additional stylish living/dining area, creating a cosy space for both family life and entertaining.

The first floor comprises of a master bedroom complete with ensuite, along with three further generous double bedrooms and a fully equipped family bathroom. This is an excellent opportunity for those seeking to acquire a spacious forever family home, ideally positioned on a private cul-de-sac within a well established and highly desirable development within the thriving town of Blessington. 

Located within walking distance of the Main Street, the property enjoys easy access to all essential amenities, including shops, schools, churches, pubs, restaurants, leisure facilities, and a range of recreational amenities. It is also within comfortable commuting distance of Dublin, Naas, the Citywest Red Line Luas, and surrounding areas. Blessington is well serviced by the Number 65 Dublin Bus route, providing direct access to Dublin City Centre.
